title: 共享内存与 IPC 内存账单：ashmem、memfd、Binder、dma-buf
key_conclusions: Shared mappings make RSS misleading because multiple processes can map the same pages.
PSS is useful for cost sharing, but producer ownership requires fd, lifecycle, and bucket-change evidence.
Killing a consumer process may remove a mapping without releasing the underlying dma-buf or shared object.
Victim benefit must be validated by post-kill PSI, MemAvailable, and global bucket movement.
shallow_points: The article does not include real dmabuf exporter samples from a device.
It does not validate Binder buffer stats commands across Android versions.
It does not provide an automated mapper-to-producer resolver.
It does not quantify how PSS redistribution changes after one consumer exits.
discovered_connections: Day 65's victim worksheet needs shared memory fields before kill benefit can be trusted.
Day 64's timing model applies to shared buffers because owner release may lag victim kill.
Day 53's bucket attribution connects global dma-buf/slab growth with app-level smaps blind spots.
Day 67 should put shared mappings into memcg and cgroup views to show per-app isolation limits.
suggest_future_topics: Day 67 should focus on memcg and cgroup isolation for apps and system processes.
Day 68 should cross-check smaps, showmap, heapprofd, and memcg for Native/System attribution.
A future tool should join /proc/pid/fd, maps, smaps, and global dma-buf stats.
A future case should show SurfaceFlinger or camera HAL retaining buffers after app death.
knowledge_gaps: Need real fd, smaps, dmabuf, and SurfaceFlinger samples from Android devices.
Need permissions and paths for dmabuf stats across vendor kernels.
Need an automated way to enumerate all mappers for one shared object.
Need before/after examples of PSS redistribution after consumer process death.

Applied Day 65's victim ownership ambiguity by separating producer, consumer, fd holder, mapper, PSS share, and kill benefit.
Applied Day 64's timing discipline by requiring global bucket movement after victim kill before accepting producer attribution.
Applied the standing more-diagrams-less-prose feedback by using seven Mermaid diagrams, compact matrices, command templates, and today's checklist.
